subject: Billing path for Redwood invoices + PO intake questions
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily@sprouthealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Billing path for Redwood invoices + PO intake questions

Hi Vivek,

Quick question from AP as we get set up with Redwood — what’s your preferred delivery channel for invoices? Our AP team can ingest via Coupa (we can invite Redwood as a supplier) or we can accept PDF invoices sent to accounts-payable@sprouthealth.com. We usually prefer portal ingestion for faster matching, but wanted to confirm Redwood’s setup and whether you need any supplier IDs or e-invoice format.

Also: 1) do you accept PO numbers (yes/no)? 2) what remittance details / tax ID should we include on the PO? 3) any minimum information you need on the invoice to avoid delays?

We’re in the US (no VAT) but will need Redwood’s W-9 / tax id on file. I can send our AP instructions; attaching our internal guide. Looking to get PO out this week if everything lines up.

Thanks,
Emily Zhang
Director, Finance Operations
Sprout Health
Attachment: Sprout_AP_instructions.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily@sprouthealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing path for Redwood invoices + PO intake questions

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear note. Short answers below and a couple of attachments to speed onboarding.

- Preferred channel: Portal (Coupa) is our preference for AP ingestion — it reduces manual processing and speeds payment turnaround. If you can invite us as a supplier via the Coupa link we’ll accept e-invoices.
- Email copies: we can also accept PDF invoices to ap@redwood.com if you need to keep email on file; please also copy accounts-payable@sprouthealth.com if you want their mailbox to have a copy.
- PO acceptance: yes, we accept POs. Please include the PO number on the invoice line and in the invoice header.
- Remittance / tax: Redwood, Inc. — EIN 12-3456789. Remit to: Redwood, Inc., 1201 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103. Wire / ACH details are in the attached template.
- Minimum invoice fields: invoice number, invoice date, PO number (if applicable), line-item descriptions, amount, tax id. That typically avoids routing delays.

I’m attaching our invoice template and a quick checklist. If Coupa onboarding is easiest for you we’ll follow that route and you can push POs directly. If you prefer email copies for now we’ll set ap@redwood.com as a backup.

Next step: Marissa (sales ops) will send a short billing-contact form via DocuSign to capture the AP contact and preferred delivery method. Once we have that + the PO we’ll set the account to your preferred channel.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_invoice_template.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily@sprouthealth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T14:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing path for Redwood invoices + PO intake questions

Thanks Emily — looping in ops to move quickly. Two quick asks so we can finalize onboarding today: 1) please confirm whether you want Coupa ingestion or email copies; 2) if you choose Coupa, can you provide the supplier onboarding contact or invite supplier id SPR-4432 (example id)?

I’ve started a DocuSign for the billing contact update (one-page form) — signing that will let us switch the account’s invoice channel and set the default payment terms. Link: https://docusign.net/Redwood-Billing-Contact-Form. I’ve attached the form as a PDF in case you prefer to e-sign offline.

We can accept PO#3321 — once we receive the PO we’ll mark the invoice with the PO and route per your chosen channel. If you have standard net terms you prefer (Net 30, Net 45, etc.) let us know and we’ll note it on the customer record.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: billing_contact_form.pdf

From: Emily Zhang <emily@sprouthealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T08:19:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Billing path for Redwood invoices + PO intake questions

Hi Marissa / Vivek — thanks, that all sounds good. We’ll onboard Redwood in Coupa and push PO#3321 this morning. I’ve attached the PO PDF for your records.

Regarding terms: Sprout typically runs Net 45 for vendor contracts of this size — would Redwood accept Net 45? If not, Net 30 is our fall-back but it would delay processing.

I’ll complete the DocuSign billing form if you need the signed copy. Once Redwood is in Coupa we’ll push invoices into the portal; let me know if you’d like email copies in parallel while the Coupa route is new.

Best,
Emily Zhang
Director, Finance Operations
Sprout Health
Attachment: Sprout_PO_3321.pdf
